full_page.content:
1928, February
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 4.
Page 7
Feb. 1st.
I 12 yr old girl lost for week - found - Enrolled - found same night
Miss Lytle - Good Position - insulted - Resigns - 7 months out of work, worried etc. now after enrolling every week is well employed and biggest company asks her back
II Penticitis Operation averted
III Mrs. Riley - Gall-stones cured without operation
Frank T, Lobeck - Enrolled little in S.M.A. asking when masses would start - child
Court Case
Cancer of Lungs - Mr. Fall N. Cath. from Cleveland
Jos. Pack - Law - Prof. of U.D. ulcer of Brain another operation this P.M.
Page 8
Feb. 8 Mary Rose Byrnes of Flint almost blind enrolled Nov. 6th. now almost perfect.
Ambrose Sloan - Cancer - operation Feb. 14th in Grand Rapids
Feb. 5th Isidora Bodert 4 yrs. away from confession - nerveous breakdown
Feb. 8 Mrs. Budd - 86 - (2508 Vermont) Rheumatic, here once last fall and quite improved since, wants to come again ....
John Platt - Throat cancer - Wife 24 - small children - hungry. Albert Dillon - Student -- Fits Herb Cayer - Stomach trouble Pat. Baker - ulser
Thomas Hoy
Ancre from Bay City
